page._comment: The pricing.html page. Everything below renders into it; nothing on that page is written in HTML.
page.title: What a listing costs
page.lede: A fixed technology and listing service fee, billed in advance for the period you choose. It pays for building and hosting your listing, keeping the details current and the site online.
page.freeNote: If you are looking for a lawyer, this page is not for you — searching, filtering and contacting an advocate is free, there is no account, and we take no share of any fee you agree with them.

includes._comment: The two feature lists. Rendered on BOTH pricing.html and list-your-practice.html from here, so the two pages cannot drift.
includes.heading: What you actually get

listing.heading: The directory listing
items: A full profile page with your own phone number on it — enrolment, experience, courts, languages, chamber address and consultation fee
Listed under every practice area and case type you actually take on, so people searching that problem find you
Findable by locality, experience, language and fee in the directory filters
A monthly count of how many people opened your profile and how many tapped call or WhatsApp — sent to you, so you can judge for yourself whether it is worth renewing
Changes made on request; removal honoured within one working day

microsite.heading: Your own microsite
items: A separate website on your own address, such as yourname.vakilsaabagra.in, with an SSL certificate
A longer account of your practice in your own words — not a copy of your directory profile
Your practice areas set out section by section, with the matters you handle under each
Answers to the questions your clients actually ask, in your own words
Call and WhatsApp always within reach on a phone, and a link that looks like yours when you send it
A choice of four looks, so it does not read like everybody else's page

items.detail: You pay for the period before it starts. There is no invoice at the end of a month and no auto-charge — nothing is stored that could take money without you doing something.
We tell you before the period ends. If you want to carry on, you pay again; if you do not reply, the listing simply stops at the date you paid up to.
Ask and we take the listing down. Your record is kept so that coming back later restores the same profile at the same address, and nothing of yours is published while you are away.

items.term: No lock-in on the monthly plan
items.detail: Stop whenever you like. The listing runs to the end of the month you have paid for and then comes down.

items.term: The microsite can be added later
items.detail: Start with the listing and add the microsite at any point; you pay the microsite rate from that month onwards.

items.q: Do you take a share of my professional fee?
items.a: No, and we never will. The fee above is the whole commercial relationship. What you agree with a client is between you and the client, and we have no visibility of it and no claim on it.

items.q: Do I pay per enquiry or per call?
items.a: No. The fee is fixed for the period, whether the phone rings once or fifty times. We count how often people tap call or WhatsApp so we can tell you how the listing is doing, not so we can bill you for it.

items.q: Does paying more move me up the results?
items.a: No. Ordering is by years in practice and how complete a profile is, and nothing you pay changes it. A directory that sells position is worth nothing to the person reading it, and that is the whole product.

items.q: Why is the microsite priced separately?
items.a: Because most advocates do not need one. The directory listing is the thing that gets you found; the microsite is a separate website with your own address and your own longer writing, and it is more to build and to keep online.

items.q: Can I see the numbers before I renew?
items.a: Yes — that is the point of sending them. Every month you get how many people opened your profile and how many tapped call or WhatsApp, so the renewal decision is yours to make on evidence rather than on our word.

items.q: Is there a discount for a group of advocates?
items.a: Ask us. Chambers taking several listings at once is a conversation worth having, and we would rather agree something in writing than publish a rate we cannot honour.

cta.heading: Ready, or want to ask first?
cta.body: Send a WhatsApp message with your name, Bar Council enrolment number, years of practice, practice areas and chamber address. We confirm the enrolment, send you a draft profile to approve, and publish it — usually within two working days.
cta.whatsappText: Hi, I am an advocate in Agra and would like to know more about being listed on Vakil Saab Agra.
